Slot Games

Slots are the cornerstone of our casino library, just as they are in every modern online casino in India.

Slot casino games for real money are the basic form of online casino games, typically containing a gridline with rows and reels populated by symbols, where you’re betting on the outcome of a spin. The gridline has a specific number of paylines, and whenever a spin ends and one or more of these paylines connect a particular number of the same symbols, you win.

Every game offers its twist on this basic premise, adding special bonus rounds and other functionalities to make the experience more entertaining. Of the 2,500+ releases on 10CRIC, 2,100+ belong to the 10CRIC slot section.

You’ll find slot online casino games with various themes on our site, including ancient Greece, Viking, and space slots. Moreover, you can experience all kinds of gameplay elements like Megaways and various bonus rounds, including free spin rounds and bonus buy options.

At 10CRIC, you can also discover the exhilarating world of Megaways Slots, where every spin unveils a dynamic and ever-changing reel layout. Developed by the Australian game innovator Big Time Gaming, Megaways is a revolutionary reel modification. True to its name, these slots offer a significantly greater number of paylines/ways to win than conventional gaming options.

Megaways is a reel modifier Australian game developer Big Time Gaming invented. As the name suggests, the number of paylines/ways to win is drastically more than in traditional games. Jackpot Games

Jackpot casino games are variations of online slots, including a much bigger max win known as the jackpot.

Most jackpot slots are games with an in-game fixed jackpot that you can win randomly in the base game or through a bonus round.

Additionally, there’s a sizable number of progressive jackpots where the pot is shared between players. Whenever a player makes a bet, a small portion is added to a joint pool for that jackpot online game. The pool increases over time, and a random casino player will eventually win that massive jackpot.
